gloss: to shake off; to break free; to outrun

definitions.gloss: to shake off; to break free from
definitions.explanation: To forcefully remove or escape from someone or something holding on.
To run faster than a pursuer and escape.
To overcome emotions, doubts, or opposition.

examples.japanese: {彼女|かのじょ}は{追|お}いすがる{彼|かれ}の{手|て}を{振|ふ}り{切|き}って{逃|に}げた。
examples.english: She shook off his clinging hand and fled.

examples.japanese: ランナーは{追跡者|ついせきしゃ}を{振|ふ}り{切|き}ってゴールした。
examples.english: The runner outran the pursuer and crossed the finish line.

examples.japanese: {迷|まよ}いを{振|ふ}り{切|き}って{決断|けつだん}した。
examples.english: I overcame my hesitation and made a decision.

examples.japanese: {警官|けいかん}の{手|て}を{振|ふ}り{切|き}って{逃走|とうそう}した。
examples.english: He shook off the police officer's grip and fled.

examples.japanese: {過去|かこ}の{しがらみ}を{振|ふ}り{切|き}る。
{子供|こども}が{母親|ははおや}の{手|て}を{振|ふ}り{切|き}って{走|はし}り{出|だ}した。
examples.english: The child shook off their mother's hand and ran off.

examples.japanese: {引|ひ}き{止|と}める{声|こえ}を{振|ふ}り{切|き}って{出|で}て{行|い}った。
examples.english: She left, shaking off the voices trying to stop her.

examples.japanese: {最後|さいご}のスパートで{他|ほか}の{選手|せんしゅ}を{振|ふ}り{切|き}った。
examples.english: In the final sprint, she outran the other athletes.

examples.japanese: パトカーを{振|ふ}り{切|き}るのは{不可能|ふかのう}だ。
examples.english: It's impossible to outrun a police car.

examples.japanese: {追|お}っ{手|て}を{振|ふ}り{切|き}って{山|やま}に{逃|に}げ{込|こ}んだ。
examples.english: He outran his pursuers and escaped into the mountains.

examples.japanese: ライバルチームを{振|ふ}り{切|き}って{優勝|ゆうしょう}した。
examples.english: They left the rival team behind and won the championship.

examples.japanese: {不安|ふあん}を{振|ふ}り{切|き}って{一歩|いっぽ}を{踏|ふ}み{出|だ}した。
examples.english: I pushed past my anxiety and took the first step.

examples.japanese: {反対|はんたい}を{振|ふ}り{切|き}って{計画|けいかく}を{実行|じっこう}した。
examples.english: They pushed past the opposition and carried out the plan.

examples.japanese: {未練|みれん}を{振|ふ}り{切|き}って{新|あたら}しい{生活|せいかつ}を{始|はじ}めた。
examples.english: I overcame my lingering attachment and started a new life.

examples.japanese: {眠気|ねむけ}を{振|ふ}り{切|き}って{仕事|しごと}を{続|つづ}けた。
examples.english: I pushed through my drowsiness and continued working.

notes:
CONJUGATION:
・{振|ふ}り{切|き}る → {振|ふ}り{切|き}らない (negative)
・{振|ふ}り{切|き}る → {振|ふ}り{切|き}って (te-form)
・{振|ふ}り{切|き}る → {振|ふ}り{切|き}った (past)

FORMATION:
Compound verb: {振|ふ}る (to shake/swing) + {切|き}る (to cut/complete)

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
・{手|て}を{振|ふ}り{切|き}る (to shake off someone's hand)
・{追|お}っ{手|て}を{振|ふ}り{切|き}る (to shake off pursuers)
・{未練|みれん}を{振|ふ}り{切|き}る (to overcome lingering attachment)
・{反対|はんたい}を{振|ふ}り{切|き}る (to push past opposition)

NUANCE:
Implies forceful action to break free from constraints, whether physical or emotional.
